listing.name: Shantae / shantaerecomp (vibecodekun)
listing.summary: Register an independently permitted Shantae Recomp Windows copy for your own exact USA ROM and retained portable state.

steps.title: Complete supported preparation upstream
steps.instruction: Use an independently permitted complete shantae-recomp Windows copy and preserve the matching runtime DLLs, assets, shaders, notices and any selected patches. Normal players use shantae.exe and the supported first-run ROM chooser; upstream owns preparation and replacement. The title’s PolyForm Noncommercial grant does not replace separately named engine, UI, shader, font or original-game terms.

steps.title: Keep the exact owned original
steps.instruction: Use your own exact Shantae USA Game Boy Color ROM, SHA-256 1b92e22d5510c51bab97d23074e4aad7464d93eb15f7596ef7da0a5efa27a19d, CRC32 E994B59B. Other releases including World, Switch and Limited Run Games are different ROMs. The chooser enables Play only for the accepted original or explicitly supported compiled patch variants; patch compatibility must be established for that actual build. No ROM is supplied or licensed by this registration.

steps.title: Attach the supported prepared player
steps.instruction: Select shantae.exe with its complete package directory as working directory and no arguments. The pinned native runtime runs the pre-boot launcher and game in-process for the normal session. Keep the supported public launcher entry and complete package; no private runner or per-title wrapper is introduced.

steps.title: Keep optional successor sessions separate
steps.instruction: Ordinary Quit ends the current process. Only explicitly choosing Return to Launcher schedules an atexit restart after saves close: on Windows that restart creates a new process without waiting. Treat that successor as upstream activity outside the attached session. Close every actual player and reopened launcher before maintenance or another attachment; registration status does not establish successor adoption or termination. This preserves the optional feature and does not disable it with arguments.

steps.title: Review Play and retain external ownership
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the exact selected executable, established working directory and literal arguments, then choose Play separately. Removing registration preserves external files. Upstream and you retain one runtime-replacement owner; Portcove provides no external update, backup, rollback, migration or deletion. Close actual players and companions before deliberate maintenance, keep the old working copy and all effective data, then review/relink changed selected bytes.

steps.title: Preserve the whole copy and effective data
steps.instruction: Keep the whole creating package, original ROM and every effective external root. Windows defaults portable state beside the executable; GBRECOMP_STATE_DIR overrides state and GBRECOMP_ASSET_DIR overrides assets. Preserve rom.cfg, keybinds.ini, runtime_prefs.ini, imgui.ini, shantae.ini, .sav battery data, .rtc, .stateN, map/patch-specific data, mods, shader_presets, shader_cache, logs and backups. Patch/native state compatibility is build-specific; do not infer save compatibility from another gbrecompiled game. Preserve per-shader licences and complete component notices.

warnings: Use only a copy and components you are independently permitted to use. No acquired-source-to-binary, gameplay, real-save, installed-client, Supported or protected acceptance is established. Preserve every original, runtime, save, setting, mod, cache, backup and custom root; another executable can share data.
